gloss: grand old figure; leading authority (of a field)

definitions.gloss: grand old figure; doyen; leading authority
definitions.explanation: A senior figure who has long held great influence in a field such as entertainment, literature, sport or politics. Historically the title of a retired shogun who still held power behind the scenes; today used of veterans, often with a hint of their weight and of the deference they receive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{演歌界|えんかかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大御所|おおごしょ}だ。
examples.english: He is the grand old man of the enka world.

examples.japanese: {大御所|おおごしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: A single word from the old master settled the matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{大御所|おおごしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}している→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: Young comedians are always tense in front of the veterans.

notes:
Very common in entertainment news (⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大御所|おおごしょ}). Originally {大御所|おおごしょ} was the residence, then the title, of a retired shogun such as ⟦{徳川家康|とくがわいえやす}→徳川家康：31006_tokugawaieyasu⟧ after he handed the office to his son.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大御所|おおごしょ}: grand old figure of show business
- ⟦{文壇|ぶんだん}→文壇：22666_bundan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大御所|おおごしょ}: elder statesman of the literary world
- {大御所|おおごしょ}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧ / ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: veteran actor / writer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重鎮|じゅうちん}→重鎮：31895_juuchin⟧: leading figure, heavyweight; more formal, stresses importance rather than seniority
- ⟦{巨匠|きょしょう}→巨匠：26809_kyoshou⟧: great master of an art; praises skill
- {第一人者|だいいちにんしゃ}: the foremost expert; stresses being top in ability
